refused.refusal: Weaviate takes no user name: clear the connection's user, and put the API key or OIDC access token in the password. Nothing was sent.

hints.text: A name or address, or a pasted http:// or https:// address such as a Weaviate Cloud endpoint, which is split into Host and Port. Studio dials this port only, never Weaviate's gRPC port 50051.

Weaviate receives the API key or OIDC access token on every request, so a key needs an SSL mode other than disable, unless the host is this machine or an SSH tunnel carries the connection. A key for a user with only the viewer role is the safest choice.

credentialWarnings.message: A Weaviate server with anonymous access on, its default, answers a request that carries no key and grants it every write, so a read-only seed without a key promises a boundary the server does not keep.
